description: This is a C# test class for functional testing of the checkout process in a web application, specifically targeting the eShopOnWeb project. It tests the flow of adding items to the basket, logging in, and completing a checkout.

classes.name: CheckoutTest
classes.description: A test class that performs end-to-end testing of the checkout process including adding items to cart, login, and checkout.

methods.name: SucessfullyPay
methods.description: Asynchronous test method that simulates a user successfully adding an item to the cart, logging in, and completing the checkout process, verifying expected responses and redirects.
